name: Governance
description: Governance arrangements proportionate to your organisation, so that decision-making, authority and oversight are clear, documented and working in practice.

solutions.name: Governance Health Check
solutions.tagline: Assess governance structures, responsibilities, authority, policies, oversight and reporting.
solutions.summary: An independent review of how your organisation is directed and controlled, benchmarked against good practice and sized to your complexity.
whoItIsFor: Boards and committees that want assurance their arrangements are fit for purpose.
Family and owner-managed businesses formalising their governance.
Organisations responding to regulator, funder or shareholder expectations.
whatWeAssess: Board and committee structure, composition and terms of reference
Delegation of authority and decision rights
Oversight of performance, risk and compliance
Quality and timeliness of board reporting
outcomes: A governance maturity assessment with clear ratings
Practical recommendations aligned to size and resources
Template charters, delegation matrix and policy register

faq.question: We are an owner-managed company. Do we really need governance?
faq.answer: Yes, proportionately. Clear roles, a delegation of authority matrix, a few short policies and structured oversight make a business easier to run, finance and eventually hand over.

faq.question: What does the governance health check assess?
faq.answer: Board and committee structure, delegation of authority and decision rights, the policy framework, oversight of performance, risk and compliance, and the quality of board reporting.

faq.question: How long does a governance health check take?
faq.answer: Usually two to four weeks, including document review, interviews and a report with a maturity rating and practical recommendations sized to your organisation.
